column1: # donor_descriptors — the per-donor half of the M1 descriptor layer (DESIGN §6.6).
# CURATED BY HAND, on purpose (C8).  Aqueous pKa is context-dependent and has no clean
# machine-readable source that covers these donor classes, so every row is entered with
# the class of reference it came from.  The metal half IS generated from a package
# (scripts/build_metal_descriptors.py) because ionic radii and electronegativity really
# are standard; mixing the two sourcing styles is the decision, not an inconsistency.
# pka  — pKa of the acid whose DEPROTONATION EXPOSES THIS DONOR, in water, at 25 C, for
#        the parent compound.  One direction only.  A neutral donor that needs no
#        activation (an amine, a pyridyl N, an ether O) has NO such acid and its pka is
#        left EMPTY, which is a meaningful answer -- "no activation step" -- and not a
#        missing value.  Basicity of a neutral donor is a different quantity; when it is
#        needed it gets its own column with its own name rather than a second meaning
# pka_sigma — honest spread, not a measurement error.  Wide where the donor class covers
#        chemically different parents (hydrohalide_X spans HF at 3.2 and HI at -10).
# default_denticity — how the GROUP usually binds: 2 for the O,O-chelators, else 1.
# source — CRC: a tabulated parent acid.  estimate: chemical judgement, no single parent.
# live_dof is deliberately NOT a column here.  It is defined by
# `mofsbu.sites.frames.live_dof()` and filled in at load time from there, so the torsion
# model has exactly one home.  A test asserts the stored column still agrees with it.
